profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Oracle
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience in developing software products in SaaS/OCI, IaaS/Private Cloud Appliance and Storage Management areas. Educated in Computer Science at the graduate level. Seasoned in Planning/Analysis/Design of Software System including Cloud Native Service, Java/Web Application development and Project Management. Domain knowledge in Cloud IaaS, Kubernetes, System/VM Administration and Storage Management.

Skill Sets: 
* Programming Languages: Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, other language experiences (Python, Go, C#)
* Cloud Infrastructure/VM/Storage: Terraform/OCI IaaS, Linux, Solaris/ZFS Storage
* Software Development Methodologies: Agile Approaches (SCRUM), Object Oriented Methodologies (Unified Process, OOSE, OMT), Traditional Methodologies (Information Engineering, BSP/ISP, ER/EER Modeling, SA/SD)
* Container/Container Orchestration Technologies: Podman/Docker, Kubernetes(OKE)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Product currently working on: OCI Secure Desktops - Infrastructure

* Products worked on as lead or individual contributor:
- Marketplace Stack for Oracle ZFS Storage in OCI v1.0.1
- Kubernetes CSI plugin for Oracle ZFS Storage Appliance v1.0.0
- etc.
